title: Taper — then sit the exam
objective: 2 hours/day. Light listening and speaking, error-log read-through. Rest Thursday. Sit TCF Canada Friday 12 February 2027.
tasks: Light listening + one short speaking session daily
Read the error log top ten once a day
Pack: passport (name must match registration), convocation, water

steps.title: Taper
steps.body: You can't add a level this week — you can only lose one by arriving tired. Light input, short speaking, read the error log. **Rest Thursday.**

steps.title: Exam-day checklist
steps.body:
Passport (name exactly as registered) · convocation · arrive early · water.
Order: CO 35 min → CE 60 min → EE 60 min → EO 12 min.
Never leave a blank in CO/CE. In EO: keep talking, fillers, never stop for a gender.

steps.title: Warm-up (the morning of)
steps.task: Two minutes: your ten question frames, then one 1-minute opinion. Just to wake the mouth up.
steps.prompt: Warm-up: 10 questions + « Qu'est-ce qui vous motive dans votre travail ? »

points: Then stop. Put the hours back into the income engine for a while.
